## Overview

Extends `--screened-lm-head` (#60566, FP8-capable CUDA GPUs only) to AMD Zen CPUs, using an INT8 screen through zentorch. Stacked on #60566, which is squashed into the first commit; please review the last two commits.

## Claims

- Greedy batches on Zen CPUs can use the screened lm_head. Every other batch keeps the full lm_head: sampling, logprobs, penalties, structured output and draft tokens.
- Same answers as the full lm_head: on GSM8K with Qwen3.5-9B W8A8, the extracted answer matches on 256/256 questions and both arms score 0.8867.
- lm_head time on Qwen3.5-9B drops to 0.55x at 1 token and 0.61x at 32 tokens (head-only proof-of-concept timing; end-to-end numbers to follow).
- Model Runner V1 rejects `--screened-lm-head` at config time.

## Validation

Unit tests: 21 pass with zentorch. Without zentorch (CI), 12 run and 9 skip.

```bash
pytest tests/v1/worker/test_zen_cpu_screened_head.py tests/test_config.py::test_v1_model_runner_rejects_screened_lm_head
```

Accuracy, on an AMD EPYC 9K65 (Zen 5) with zentorch 2.14.0.1, 48 cores per run:

```bash
lm_eval --model vllm \
  --model_args pretrained=RedHatAI/Qwen3.5-9B-quantized.w8a8,dtype=bfloat16,max_model_len=4096[,screened_lm_head=True] \
  --tasks gsm8k --num_fewshot 5 --limit 256 --batch_size auto --gen_kwargs max_gen_toks=2048 --trust_remote_code
```

| `--screened-lm-head` | strict-match | flexible-extract |
|---|---|---|
| off | 0.8867 | 0.8867 |
| off, repeat | 0.8711 | 0.8633 |
| on | 0.8867 | 0.8867 |

With the screen on, the extracted answer matches the first flag-off run on 256/256 questions, and 1,739 of 1,788 head calls were screened. The repeat flag-off run shows the baseline's run-to-run variation; each run had its own compile cache.

Performance: lm_head time on Qwen3.5-9B (248,320 x 4,096), from a proof-of-concept of the same screen on vLLM 0.31.0, on a 32-core Zen 5 pod with threads pinned per core. One run.

| tokens | 1 | 4 | 8 | 16 | 32 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| full head (ms) | 43.6 | 50.2 | 72.2 | 111.1 | 230.8 |
| screened (ms) | 23.8 | 29.7 | 40.3 | 70.4 | 140.8 |

Without per-thread pinning, the screen was slower at 1-4 tokens. End-to-end `vllm bench serve` results will follow.

## Details

- An INT8 per-row copy of the BF16 lm_head is scored with `zentorch_dynamic_qlinear` (`ZentorchInt8ScaledMMLinearKernel`). Rows that cannot be the argmax get `-inf`, and only the survivors are recomputed in BF16 with `zentorch_bmm`.
- The screen declines a batch, and the full lm_head runs, when more than 1/16 of the vocabulary survives or the batch has more than 256 tokens.
- `ScreenedLMHead` gains `unsupported_platform_reason()`, and its `__call__` may return `None` to decline a batch. `GPUModelRunner.screened_head_cls` lets `CPUModelRunner` pick `ZenScreenedLMHead` (`vllm/v1/worker/cpu/screened_lm_head.py`).
- Cost: an INT8 copy of the lm_head, +1.0 GB on Qwen3.5-9B.

+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import numpy as np
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.zentorch_utils import has_zentorch_op
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.sampling_params import SamplingParams
+from vllm.v1.worker.cpu import buffer_utils as cpu_buffer_utils
+from vllm.v1.worker.cpu.screened_lm_head import (
+    _OPS,
+    ZenScreenedLMHead,
+    _bound,
+    _quantize_rows,
+)
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu import buffer_utils as gpu_buffer_utils
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.model_runner import GPUModelRunner
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.sample.sampler import Sampler
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.states import RequestState
+
+VOCAB_SIZE = 16384
+HIDDEN_SIZE = 512
+GAMMA = HIDDEN_SIZE * 2.0**-24 / (1 - HIDDEN_SIZE * 2.0**-24)
+MAX_TOKENS = ZenScreenedLMHead.MAX_TOKENS
+
+requires_zentorch = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not (current_platform.is_zen_cpu() and has_zentorch_op(_OPS)),
+    reason="The INT8 screen needs an AMD Zen CPU with zentorch",
+)
+
+
+def _weight(rows: int = VOCAB_SIZE) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return (torch.randn(rows, HIDDEN_SIZE) * 0.02).bfloat16()
+
+
+def _near_tie_inputs(weight: torch.Tensor, num_tokens: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Hidden states whose two best rows are pulled close to a tie."""
+    x = torch.randn(num_tokens, weight.shape[1])
+    logits = F.linear(x.to(weight.dtype), weight).float()
+    top2 = logits.topk(2, dim=-1)
+    diff = weight[top2.indices[:, 0]].float() - weight[top2.indices[:, 1]].float()
+    gap = top2.values[:, 0] - top2.values[:, 1]
+    shrink = torch.rand(num_tokens, 1)
+    return (x - shrink * (gap / diff.norm(dim=-1).square())[:, None] * diff).to(
+        weight.dtype
+    )
+
+
+def _inputs(kind: str, weight: torch.Tensor, num_tokens: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    if kind == "near-tie":
+        return _near_tie_inputs(weight, num_tokens)
+    if kind == "one-hot":
+        return torch.eye(num_tokens, HIDDEN_SIZE).bfloat16()
+    if kind == "outlier":
+        # Every small entry rounds up from just above half an INT8 step.
+        x = torch.full((num_tokens, HIDDEN_SIZE), 97 / 16384)
+        x[:, 0] = 1.5
+        return x.bfloat16()
+    return torch.randn(num_tokens, HIDDEN_SIZE).bfloat16()
+
+
+def _emulated_screen(
+    x: torch.Tensor, q: torch.Tensor, scale: torch.Tensor
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """zentorch_dynamic_qlinear in torch: per-token INT8 activations, exact
+    integer accumulation, BF16 output."""
+    xf = x.float()
+    t = (xf.abs().amax(1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1e-10) / 127).clamp(min=1e-10)
+    acc = torch.round(xf / t).double() @ q.double().T
+    return (acc * t.bfloat16().double() * scale.double()).bfloat16().float()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def sampler(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> Sampler:
+    # The CPU worker makes this swap process-wide in vllm/v1/worker/cpu/shm.py.
+    monkeypatch.setattr(gpu_buffer_utils, "UvaBuffer", cpu_buffer_utils.UvaBuffer)
+    req_states = RequestState(
+        max_num_reqs=4,
+        max_model_len=64,
+        max_num_batched_tokens=16,
+        num_speculative_steps=1,
+        vocab_size=VOCAB_SIZE,
+        device=torch.device("cpu"),
+    )
+    return Sampler(
+        vllm_config=SimpleNamespace(reasoning_config=None),
+        max_num_reqs=4,
+        vocab_size=VOCAB_SIZE,
+        device=torch.device("cpu"),
+        req_states=req_states,
+    )
+
+
+class _FixedScreen:
+    """A screen that serves every greedy batch with fixed logits."""
+
+    def __init__(self, logits: torch.Tensor | None):

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Greedy logits from an INT8 screen of a BF16 lm_head on AMD Zen CPUs.
+
+zentorch_dynamic_qlinear scores every row j as s_j from a per-row INT8 copy W8
+of the lm_head W. It quantizes each token x as x8 = round(x / t) * bf16(t) with
+t = absmax(x) / 127. With e_j = ||W_j - W8_j||, Rh_j = ||W8_j||,
+R_j = max(||W_j||, ||W8_j||), r = ||x - x8|| / ||x|| and gamma_K the fp32
+accumulation error over K terms, the BF16 head's logit F_j satisfies
+|F_j - s_j| <= beta_j with
+
+    G_j = Rh_j ||x - x8|| + e_j ||x|| + gamma_K R_j ||x|| (2 + r) (1 + 2^-7)
+    beta_j = G_j (1 + 2^-7) + 2^-7 (1 + 2^-5) |s_j|
+
+where the |s_j| term covers the BF16 rounding of both outputs. A row with
+s_j + beta_j below max_i (s_i - beta_i) is beaten by that row i, so only the
+rows above it are recomputed in BF16 and every other row gets -inf. The argmax
+matches the full lm_head except on ties within one output ulp, which depend on
+summation order. The screen reads half the bytes of the BF16 head.
+"""
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear import (
+    ZentorchInt8ScaledMMLinearKernel,
+    init_int8_linear_kernel,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.zentorch_utils import has_zentorch_op
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.sample.sampler import Sampler
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.sample.screened_head import ScreenedLMHead
+
+_QUANT_CHUNK = 16384
+_OPS = ["zentorch_dynamic_qlinear", "zentorch_bmm", "zentorch_clear_weight_cache"]
+
+
+def _up(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Round a non-negative fp32 bound outward."""
+    return x * (1 + 2.0**-20)
+
+
+def _quantize_rows(
+    w: torch.Tensor,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Per-row INT8 copy of w, its BF16 scale, and the stacked row norms
+    e, Rh and R of the module docstring."""
+    w = w.float()
+    scale = (w.abs().amax(1, keepdim=True) / 127).bfloat16().float()
+    scale = torch.where(scale == 0, torch.ones_like(scale), scale)
+    q = torch.round(w / scale).clamp_(-127, 127)
+    w_hat, w = (q * scale).double(), w.double()
+    w_norm, w_hat_norm = w.norm(dim=1), w_hat.norm(dim=1)
+    stats = torch.stack(
+        [(w - w_hat).norm(dim=1), w_hat_norm, torch.maximum(w_norm, w_hat_norm)]
+    )
+    return q.to(torch.int8), scale.view(-1).bfloat16(), _up(stats.float())
+
+
+def _bound(
+    x: torch.Tensor, s: torch.Tensor, stats: torch.Tensor, gamma: float
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, bool]:
+    """The module docstring's beta for screen logits s of x, and whether
+    ||x|| is finite."""
+    xf, xd = x.float(), x.double()
+    t = (xf.abs().amax(1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1e-10) / 127).clamp(min=1e-10)
+    x_hat = torch.round(xf / t) * t.bfloat16().float()
+    xn = _up(xd.norm(dim=1, keepdim=True).float())
+    eta = _up((xd - x_hat.double()).norm(dim=1, keepdim=True).float())
+    r = torch.where(xn > 0, eta / xn, torch.zeros_like(xn))
+    err, w_hat_norm, w_max_norm = stats.unsqueeze(1)
+    beta = w_hat_norm * eta
+    beta.addcmul_(err, xn)
+    beta.addcmul_(w_max_norm, gamma * (2 + r) * (1 + 2.0**-7) * xn)
+    beta.mul_(1 + 2.0**-7).add_(s.abs(), alpha=2.0**-7 * (1 + 2.0**-5))
+    beta.mul_(1 + 2.0**-20).add_(1e-30)
+    return beta, bool(torch.isfinite(xn).all())
+
+
+class ZenScreenedLMHead(ScreenedLMHead):
+    """ScreenedLMHead for greedy batches on AMD Zen CPUs: an INT8 screen through
+    zentorch_dynamic_qlinear and a BF16 recheck of the surviving rows."""
+
+    MAX_TOKENS = 256
+    # zentorch_bmm is 30-100x slower on fewer rows from 4 tokens up.
+    MIN_RECHECK_ROWS = 2048
+
+    @classmethod
+    def unsupported_platform_reason(cls) -> str | None:
+        if current_platform.is_zen_cpu() and has_zentorch_op(_OPS):
+            return None
+        return "an AMD Zen CPU with zentorch"
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        weight: torch.Tensor,
+        vocab_size: int,
+        sampler: Sampler,
+        max_num_tokens: int,
+    ):
+        if (
+            weight.dim() != 2
+            or weight.dtype != torch.bfloat16
+            or weight.shape[0] < vocab_size
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("screened_lm_head requires a BF16 lm_head on Zen CPUs.")
+        self.kernel = init_int8_linear_kernel(
+            is_channelwise=True,
+            is_static_input_scheme=False,
+            input_symmetric=True,
+            module_name=type(self).__name__,
+        )
+        if not isinstance(self.kernel, ZentorchInt8ScaledMMLinearKernel):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "screened_lm_head requires the zentorch int8 linear kernel."
+            )
+        self.weight = weight[:vocab_size]
+        self.sampler = sampler
+        self.vocab_size, self.hidden_size = self.weight.shape
+        self.max_num_tokens = min(max_num_tokens, self.MAX_TOKENS)
+        # Past this many surviving rows the recheck costs more than it saves.
+        self.max_union = self.vocab_size // 16
+        k_u = self.hidden_size * 2.0**-24
+        self.gamma = k_u / (1 - k_u)
+        self.layer = torch.nn.Module()
+        self.layer.weight = torch.nn.Parameter(
+            torch.empty_like(self.weight, dtype=torch.int8), requires_grad=False
+        )
+        self.layer.weight_scale = torch.nn.Parameter(
+            torch.empty(self.vocab_size, dtype=torch.bfloat16), requires_grad=False
+        )
+        self.stats = torch.empty(3, self.vocab_size)
+        self.refresh()
+
+    def refresh(self) -> None:
+        """Rebuild the INT8 copy and its row norms from the lm_head weight."""
+        for start in range(0, self.vocab_size, _QUANT_CHUNK):
+            rows = slice(start, start + _QUANT_CHUNK)
+            q, scale, stats = _quantize_rows(self.weight[rows])
+            self.layer.weight.data[rows] = q
+            self.layer.weight_scale.data[rows] = scale
+            self.stats[:, rows] = stats
+        # ZenDNN caches reordered constant weights by address, so an in-place
+        # update is invisible to it until the cache is cleared.
+        torch.ops.zentorch.zentorch_clear_weight_cache()
+
+    def required_top_k(self, idx_mapping_np: np.ndarray, num_tokens: int) -> int | None:
+        temperature = self.sampler.sampling_states.temperature.np[idx_mapping_np]
+        if np.any(temperature != 0.0):
+            return None
+        return super().required_top_k(idx_mapping_np, num_tokens)
+
+    def __call__(self, x: torch.Tensor, top_k: int = 1) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+        if top_k != 1 or not 0 < x.shape[0] <= self.max_num_tokens:
+            return None
+        x = x.contiguous()
+        s = self.kernel.apply_weights(self.layer, x).float()
+        beta, finite = _bound(x, s, self.stats, self.gamma)
+        keep = (s + beta) >= (s - beta).amax(1, keepdim=True)
+        cols = keep.any(0).nonzero().flatten()
+        n = cols.numel()
+        if not finite or not 0 < n <= self.max_union:
+            return None
+        idx = cols
+        if n < self.MIN_RECHECK_ROWS:
+            idx = torch.cat([cols, cols[-1:].expand(self.MIN_RECHECK_ROWS - n)])
+        # zentorch_bmm does not cache its weight; zentorch_mm and
+        # zentorch_linear_unary would, by the address of this temporary.
+        exact = torch.ops.zentorch.zentorch_bmm(
+            x.unsqueeze(0), self.weight.index_select(0, idx).unsqueeze(0).mT
+        )[0, :, :n]
+        logits = x.new_full((x.shape[0], self.vocab_size), float("-inf"))
+        logits[:, cols] = exact
+        return logits

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Top-k logits from an FP8 screen of the lm_head plus exact logits.
+
+An FP8 copy of the lm_head scores every row j as s_j. Row j's logit as the full
+head computes it before rounding, c_j, satisfies |c_j - s_j| <= ||x|| * err_j:
+Cauchy-Schwarz on W_j - W8_j plus the fp32 accumulation error of both GEMMs.
+Let t be the k-th largest per-block maximum of s_j - ||x|| err_j: at least k
+rows have c_j >= t. A row whose upper bound is below t - 2 eps |t| sits more
+than one output ulp below each of them, so it can neither enter nor tie the
+full head's top k. The remaining rows get exact logits and every other row
+-inf. Greedy sampling (k = 1) and top-k sampling only read the top k, so they
+return the full head's token for the same seed (up to sub-ulp ties that depend
+on summation order, as with any GEMM change). The screen reads half the bytes
+of a BF16 head.
+"""
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+
+import vllm.envs as envs
+from vllm import _custom_ops as ops
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.linear import UnquantizedLinearMethod
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.logits_processor import LogitsProcessor
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.vocab_parallel_embedding import (
+    UnquantizedEmbeddingMethod,
+    VocabParallelEmbedding,
+)
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.sample.sampler import Sampler
+
+_QUANT_CHUNK = 4096
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _screen_kernel(
+    x_ptr,
+    w_ptr,
+    scale_ptr,
+    err_ptr,
+    ub_ptr,
+    block_max_ptr,
+    num_tokens,
+    vocab_size,
+    hidden_size,
+    BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_V: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_H: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    block = tl.program_id(0)
+    rows = block * BLOCK_V + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_V)
+    toks = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)
+    row_mask = rows < vocab_size
+    tok_mask = toks < num_tokens
+    acc = tl.zeros([BLOCK_N, BLOCK_V], dtype=tl.float32)
+    sq = tl.zeros([BLOCK_N], dtype=tl.float32)
+    for h0 in range(0, hidden_size, BLOCK_H):
+        cols = h0 + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_H)
+        col_mask = cols < hidden_size
+        x = tl.load(
+            x_ptr + toks[:, None] * hidden_size + cols[None, :],
+            mask=tok_mask[:, None] & col_mask[None, :],
+            other=0.0,
+        )
+        w = tl.load(
+            w_ptr + rows[None, :].to(tl.int64) * hidden_size + cols[:, None],
+            mask=row_mask[None, :] & col_mask[:, None],
+            other=0.0,
+        )
+        acc = tl.dot(x, w.to(x.dtype), acc)
+        xf = x.to(tl.float32)
+        sq += tl.sum(xf * xf, axis=1)
+    s = acc * tl.load(scale_ptr + rows, mask=row_mask, other=0.0)[None, :]
+    bound = tl.sqrt(sq)[:, None] * tl.load(err_ptr + rows, mask=row_mask, other=0.0)
+    mask = tok_mask[:, None] & row_mask[None, :]
+    lb = tl.where(mask, s - bound, float("-inf"))
+    tl.store(
+        block_max_ptr + toks * tl.num_programs(0) + block,
+        tl.max(lb, axis=1),
+        mask=tok_mask,
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        ub_ptr + toks[:, None].to(tl.int64) * vocab_size + rows[None, :],
+        s + bound,
+        mask=mask,
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _select_kernel(
+    ub_ptr,
+    t_ptr,
+    logits_ptr,
+    cand_ptr,
+    num_cand_ptr,
+    vocab_size,
+    TIE: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    tok = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    cols = tl.program_id(1) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    mask = cols < vocab_size
+    t = tl.load(t_ptr + tok)
+    ub = tl.load(ub_ptr + tok * vocab_size + cols, mask=mask, other=float("-inf"))
+    keep = mask & (ub >= t - TIE * tl.abs(t))
+    tl.store(logits_ptr + tok * vocab_size + cols, float("-inf"), mask=mask)
+    num_keep = tl.sum(keep.to(tl.int32), axis=0)
+    if num_keep > 0:
+        base = tl.atomic_add(num_cand_ptr + tok, num_keep)
+        offs = base + tl.cumsum(keep.to(tl.int32), axis=0) - 1
+        tl.store(cand_ptr + tok * vocab_size + offs, cols, mask=keep)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _exact_kernel(
+    x_ptr,
+    w_ptr,
+    cand_ptr,
+    num_cand_ptr,
+    logits_ptr,
+    vocab_size,
+    hidden_size,
+    BLOCK_R: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_H: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    tok = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    num_cand = tl.load(num_cand_ptr + tok)
+    step = tl.num_programs(1) * BLOCK_R
+    for start in range(tl.program_id(1) * BLOCK_R, num_cand, step):
+        r = start + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_R)
+        r_mask = r < num_cand
+        rows = tl.load(cand_ptr + tok * vocab_size + r, mask=r_mask, other=0)
+        rows = rows.to(tl.int64)
+        acc = tl.zeros([BLOCK_R], dtype=tl.float32)
+        for h0 in range(0, hidden_size, BLOCK_H):
+            cols = h0 + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_H)
+            col_mask = cols < hidden_size
+            x = tl.load(x_ptr + tok * hidden_size + cols, mask=col_mask, other=0.0)
+            w = tl.load(
+                w_ptr + rows[:, None] * hidden_size + cols[None, :],
+                mask=r_mask[:, None] & col_mask[None, :],
+                other=0.0,
+            )
+            acc += tl.sum(w.to(tl.float32) * x.to(tl.float32)[None, :], axis=1)
+        tl.store(
+            logits_ptr + tok * vocab_size + rows,
+            acc.to(logits_ptr.dtype.element_ty),
+            mask=r_mask,
+        )
+
+
+class ScreenedLMHead:
+    """lm_head logits for batches that only read the top k, exact on every row
+    that can be among them and -inf elsewhere."""
+
+    # Tiles and caps were measured on GB10 (lm_head 248320 x 2560): greedy, the
+    # screen beats the BF16 head by 39% at 64 tokens and loses beyond 96, where
+    # the GEMM is no longer bandwidth bound; top-32 still wins by 23% at 64.
+    MAX_TOKENS = 64
+    MAX_TOP_K = 32
+    BLOCK_V = 64
+    BLOCK_H = 256
+    SELECT_BLOCK = 4096
+    EXACT_PROGRAMS = 64
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        weight: torch.Tensor,
+        vocab_size: int,
+        sampler: Sampler,
+        max_num_tokens: int,
+    ):
+        self.weight = weight[:vocab_size]
+        self.sampler = sampler
+        self.vocab_size, self.hidden_size = self.weight.shape
+        self.max_num_tokens = min(max_num_tokens, self.MAX_TOKENS)
+        # One output ulp is at most eps * |logit|; argmax ties resolve to the
+        # lowest index.
+        self.tie = 2 * torch.finfo(weight.dtype).eps
+        self.w_fp8 = torch.empty_like(self.weight, dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+        self.scale = torch.empty(self.vocab_size, device=weight.device)
+        self.err = torch.empty(self.vocab_size, device=weight.device)
+        self.ub = torch.empty(
+            self.max_num_tokens, self.vocab_size, device=weight.device
+        )
+        self.cand = torch.empty_like(self.ub, dtype=torch.int32)
+        self.block_max = torch.empty(
+            self.max_num_tokens,
+            triton.cdiv(self.vocab_size, self.BLOCK_V),
+            device=weight.device,
+        )
+        self.refresh()
+
+    def refresh(self) -> None:
+        """Rebuild the FP8 copy and its error bounds from the lm_head weight."""
+        u = 2.0**-24
+        # fp32 accumulation error over hidden_size terms, relative to
+        # sum_i |x_i w_i| <= ||x|| ||w||.
+        gamma = self.hidden_size * u / (1 - self.hidden_size * u)
+        for start in range(0, self.vocab_size, _QUANT_CHUNK):
+            rows = slice(start, start + _QUANT_CHUNK)
+            _, scale = ops.scaled_fp8_quant(
+                self.weight[rows],
+                use_per_token_if_dynamic=True,
+                output=self.w_fp8[rows],
+            )
+            self.scale[rows] = scale.view(-1)
+            w = self.weight[rows].double()
+            deq = self.w_fp8[rows].double() * scale.double()
+            err = (
+                (w - deq).norm(dim=1)
+                + gamma * w.norm(dim=1)
+                + (gamma + 2 * u) * deq.norm(dim=1)
+            )
+            # Slack for the fp32 norm of x and the fp32 bound arithmetic.
+            self.err[rows] = err * (1 + 4 * gamma)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def unsupported_platform_reason(cls) -> str | None:
+        """What the current platform lacks for this screen, or None."""
+        if current_platform.is_cuda() and current_platform.has_device_capability(89):
+            return None
+        return "an FP8-capable CUDA GPU (compute capability 8.9+)"
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_model(
+        cls,
+        model: torch.nn.Module,
+        sampler: Sampler,
+        vocab_size: int,
+        max_num_tokens: int,
+    ) -> "ScreenedLMHead":
+        get_language_model = getattr(model, "get_language_model", None)
+        language_model = get_language_model() if get_language_model else model
+        lm_head = getattr(language_model, "lm_head", None)
+        processor = getattr(language_model, "logits_processor", None)
+        reason = None
+        if (platform_reason := cls.unsupported_platform_reason()) is not None:
+            reason = platform_reason
+        elif envs.VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT:
+            # Whether a request is screened depends on the rest of its batch.
+            reason = "VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT to be off"
+        elif (
+            type(sampler) is not Sampler
+            or sampler.compute_nans
+            or sampler.trace_replay_state is not None
+            or sampler.return_sampling_mask
+        ):
+            reason = "the default sampler without NaN checks or trace replay"
+        elif not isinstance(lm_head, VocabParallelEmbedding) or not isinstance(
+            lm_head.quant_method, (UnquantizedEmbeddingMethod, UnquantizedLinearMethod)
+        ):
+            reason = "an unquantized lm_head"
+        elif lm_head.tp_size > 1 or getattr(lm_head, "bias", None) is not None:
+            reason = "an lm_head without TP sharding or bias"
+        elif lm_head.weight.dtype not in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16):
+            reason = "a BF16 or FP16 lm_head"
+        elif (
+            not isinstance(processor, LogitsProcessor)
+            or processor.logits_as_input
+            or processor.soft_cap is not None
+            or processor.scale != 1.0
+            or processor.head_dtype not in (None, lm_head.weight.dtype)
+        ):
+            reason = "logits that are the plain lm_head projection (no LoRA)"
+        if reason is not None:
+            raise ValueError(f"screened_lm_head requires {reason}.")
+        assert lm_head is not None
+        weight = lm_head.weight.data
+        head = cls(weight, vocab_size, sampler, max_num_tokens)
+        # Compile the kernels now rather than on the first request.
+        for num_tokens in (1, 17, 33):
+            if num_tokens <= head.max_num_tokens:
+                head(torch.randn_like(weight[:num_tokens]))
+        return head
+
+    def required_top_k(self, idx_mapping_np: np.ndarray, num_tokens: int) -> int | None:
+        """How many top logits sampling the batch reads (1 when all greedy), or
+        None when it needs more than the screen certifies."""
+        sampler = self.sampler
+        states = sampler.sampling_states
+        if (
+            not 0 < num_tokens <= self.max_num_tokens
+            or np.any(sampler.uses_logits_processors[idx_mapping_np])
+            or sampler.get_logprobs_dims(idx_mapping_np) is not None
+        ):
+            return None
+        sampled = idx_mapping_np[states.temperature.np[idx_mapping_np] != 0.0]
+        if sampled.size == 0:
+            return 1
+        # Without top-k, top-p reads the whole distribution; min-p is applied
+        # before top-k.
+        top_k = int(states.top_k.np[sampled].max())
+        if top_k > min(self.MAX_TOP_K, self.block_max.shape[1]) or np.any(
+            states.min_p.np[sampled] != 0.0
+        ):
+            return None
+        return top_k
+
+    def __call__(self, x: torch.Tensor, top_k: int = 1) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+        """The screened logits, or None when a subclass declines the batch and
+        the caller must use the full lm_head."""
+        num_tokens = x.shape[0]
+        vocab_size = self.vocab_size
+        assert num_tokens <= self.max_num_tokens
+        x = x.contiguous()
+        ub = self.ub[:num_tokens]
+        cand = self.cand[:num_tokens]
+        block_max = self.block_max[:num_tokens]
+        # A single token block, so the FP8 weights are read once.
+        block_n = max(16, triton.next_power_of_2(num_tokens))
+        _screen_kernel[(triton.cdiv(vocab_size, self.BLOCK_V),)](
+            x,
+            self.w_fp8,
+            self.scale,
+            self.err,
+            ub,
+            block_max,
+            num_tokens,
+            vocab_size,
+            self.hidden_size,
+            BLOCK_N=block_n,
+            BLOCK_V=self.BLOCK_V,
+            BLOCK_H=self.BLOCK_H,
+        )
+        t = block_max.topk(top_k, dim=-1).values[:, -1].contiguous()
+        logits = torch.empty(num_tokens, vocab_size, device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
+        num_cand = torch.zeros(num_tokens, device=x.device, dtype=torch.int32)
+        _select_kernel[(num_tokens, triton.cdiv(vocab_size, self.SELECT_BLOCK))](
+            ub,
+            t,
+            logits,
+            cand,
+            num_cand,
+            vocab_size,
+            TIE=self.tie,
+            BLOCK=self.SELECT_BLOCK,
+        )
+        _exact_kernel[(num_tokens, self.EXACT_PROGRAMS)](
+            x,
+            self.weight,
+            cand,
+            num_cand,
+            logits,
+            vocab_size,
+            self.hidden_size,
+            BLOCK_R=4,
+            BLOCK_H=self.BLOCK_H,
+        )
+        return logits
